newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-BHP says loses 100,000 T iron output.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-BHP says loses 100,000 T iron output.

text.p: The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd (BHP) said its steel division had advised Port Kembla steelworks would lose about 100,000 toness of iron production after a breakout of molten iron at No. 5 Blast Furnace last Friday.

BHP Steel said the blast furnace was shut down after a breakout around one of the tapholes causing a quantity of molten iron to run down the furnace shell, damaging the shell plate and parts of the furnace cooling system.
It said the furnace shutdown was conducted safely and without injury.
Repairs were expected to take about one week to complete.
Deliveries to customers in Australia were not expected to be affected by the incident. However, timing of some export shipments would need to be rescheduled, the company said.
The Port Kembla Steelworks, in New South Wales, produced 4.5 million tonnes of iron in the year ending May 31, 1996.
